quest.title: Time to Test the Twilight Cruise!
quest.description: The flagship attraction, "Twilight Cruise," is waiting for professional testers...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: You're here! Looks like the staff had to step out for a bit, but I've pretty much figured out how to take it for a spin... ahem, yeah, for testing purposes!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great, then show us the ropes!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Basically, one person rides the boat while the other sends signals to the saurian staff. Working as a team, the aim is to safely guide the boat to its destination.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #So I'm pretty confident — 'cause when it comes to teamwork, {NICKNAME} and I have it down to a T!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh really? Well, don't get too confident, or you might end up capsizing...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Whoa, Paimon, don't go around jinxing people!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, okay... Then Paimon wishes you... smooth sailing?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hehe, that goes without saying.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I'm actually kind of in the mood to ride the boat. I'm used to tough surfing challenges, so it'll be fun to switch it up!

choices.text: I'm kinda tired of the Waverider too.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: See, we're in perfect sync already! That's gotta be proof of our bond, huh?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Can't wait to pump up my inflatable swimsuit and bounce right onto the boat!

choices.text: I'll take care of the signals.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: ...Oh, so the facilities here are still under construction.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, there's an iktomisaur employee! Should we ask him for help?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hi there! Any chance you could give us a hand getting these built?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Um... Put... here... and build...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Doesn't look like he understands...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Yeah... Hmm, what should we do now?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: ...Ohhhhh, hold on! A stroke of genius just came to me!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Eee!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Eee! Eee! Eee!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hah, nope... Well at least we know he doesn't speak koholasaur!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't we just—

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Oh, I've got another idea!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What now?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I once heard Ifa mention that iktomisaurs go wild for Glowing Hornshrooms, and guess what I happen to have on me...?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: This has gotta be it! Once he eats this, we'll totally be on the same wavelength!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: There's no such thing as packing too much when you're heading out on a long trip... Kachina was spot on. Gotta remember to thank her for this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhhh, whatever that was, it's definitely not the wavelength Paimon's on...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: What a disaster... Day one, and there goes my dream of conquering all the challenges in Wavey Bay...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Got any ideas, {NICKNAME}, o great hero of Natlan...?

choices.text: I can fetch another iktomisaur to help.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You return, having indwelt an iktomisaurus...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mualani, we're back!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Oh, hey there! Aww, aren't you just the cutest? Wait, where'd {NICKNAME} go?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Uh, {M#he}{F#she}... {M#His}{F#Her} stomach started acting up, so {M#he}{F#she} had to run to the bathroom...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Seriously Paimon, that's such a lame cover story. Never mind, as long as Mualani buys it...)

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: My, you're a friendly one! Wanna try a Glowing Hornshroom? Here, have at it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (A curious flavor, indeed. Thick, juicy, and surprisingly delicious, for a mushroom...)

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Haha, glad you liked it! Here, they're all yours.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: C—Can I pet you? C'mon, let's be friends!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Also, could you... do me a favor?

talks.objective: Use the ability of an Iktomisaur to complete construction

dialogues.speaker: Iktomisaurus Chick
dialogues.text: What is she yammering on about!? I don't understand. My friend asked me to look after this place... No one said anything about manual labor...

dialogues.speaker: Iktomisaurus Chick
dialogues.text: But those mushrooms tasted nice... If it means I can get some more of them...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Phew, looks like we're all done!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Thank you! I couldn't have done it without your help.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Mind if I pet you again? Aww, that's a good little buddy... You're the best!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... Mualani, it's probably about time we took our friend back home.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Oh, sure. I'll wait here in case {NICKNAME} gets back in the meantime.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Such cute little things! Maybe I should get Granny to teach me some iktomisaur...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Oh, hey {NICKNAME}, how's the stomach?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Absolutely fine, thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Glad to hear it. Oh, you won't believe it — you just missed the sweetest little iktomisaur! Seriously, so adorable!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: It almost makes me wanna go stay with the Masters of the Night-Wind for a while, just so I can pick some more Glowing Hornshrooms and spend some time bonding with them!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Well then, the test here is complete. Let me mark that down for you... Alright, the next location is on the other shore.
